name: 19484-video-qwen25vl-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration -- a 28-layer bf16 decoder (28 query heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 3584) behind a 32-layer vision tower; ~8.3B params, ~16.6 GB of weights. Everything else reads off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 300 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. The 320 request rows are PRE-BUILT before the first request is sent (`spec.data_loader.samples`), so no image is synthesised inside the measurement window.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_image` + `synthetic_text`, zipped into one request: one 4480x2520 flat-colour JPEG (q85, seed 42, a different colour on every row) and one 32-token question, answered in exactly 32 tokens at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos. Single turn, no prefix_buckets, a DIFFERENT image on every request, so vLLM's mm-processor cache misses every time and the media is hashed and processed afresh. The engine is given the vision budget min_pixels=3136 / max_pixels=401408, so the image expands to 480 placeholder tokens and a request is ~512 prompt tokens, not 32 -- measured, not estimated.
purpose: A visual question-answering service for high-resolution images, serving eight concurrent users short answers on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 16c16301c8218a28eefcdec07757a782e5ddc643 (v0.9.1-145-g16c16301c821).
# Interpreter and hardware live in configs/env.yaml, which is this machine's and NOT portable.
# The load is not here -- it is scenario.json.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The vision budget is the operating point, not a tuning knob. The per-request media buffer is
# hashed at FULL resolution before the HF processor runs (processing.py: _hash_mm_items is called
# on the raw parsed item), so capping pixels leaves the 31.6 MiB hashed buffer untouched while
# cutting both the processor's CPU cost and the GPU's token count by ~10x. Without it the run is
# processor-bound and the frontend it is pointed at disappears into the noise. 512 vision tokens.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"min_pixels": 3136, "max_pixels": 401408}

# 512 vision placeholder tokens plus a 32-token question and 32 tokens out. Far inside the
# checkpoint's 128000; kept generous so a resize that lands slightly over cannot truncate.
max-model-len: 32768

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
